title: Data pack manifest (pack.yaml)
description: Optional at contract version 1: says what the pack is, which contract it follows and what produced it. The server does not read it; the validator does (bbox enables the 'location outside the area' warning).

schema_version.description: Data-pack contract version this pack follows. Only 1 exists.

id.description: Machine name of the pack, for example austin-travis-tx.

name.description: Human name, for example Austin and Travis County, Texas.

bbox.description: Service area as [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees. Locations outside it are warned about.

generated_by.description: 'human', or the tool name and version that wrote the pack, for example catalog-research 0.3.0.

generated_at.description: Date or ISO 8601 timestamp the pack was produced.

notes.description: Free text: sources, caveats, review status.
